benchmarkSummary: A separate held-out study tested the lightweight DM-VTON research model on 100 upper-body cases. It came closer to the reference than the previous overlay in 64 cases (29 of 50 men, 35 of 50 women). A 12-case visual review found five material fit discrepancies and seven major geometry or occlusion errors. The study used a separate set of synthetic people and garments.
method: These 100 gallery cases used 100 synthetic adults and 100 garment references. A generative image editor received matching person and product reference sheets, ten pairs per batch. Each result is displayed beside its own two inputs. The live fitting room uses WeShopAI for new uploads by default. Its live checks included the Oxford shirt on Omar and the cream knit on Maya.

reviewSummary: A model-assisted visual inspection checked wearer likeness, garment details and plausible folds, hands and layering. 89 of 100 gallery images met all three checks. 11 are marked for review. The reference photos are synthetic and provide no physical size measurement.
